        return
    line_index = 0
    test_count_line = input_lines[line_index].strip()
    line_index += 1
    if not test_count_line:
        return

    b_str = input_lines[line_index].split()
    line_index += 1

    b = list(map(int, b_str))
    
    alice_points = 0
    bob_points = 0

    if a[0] != 0:
        alice_points += min(a[0], b[1])

        alice_points += min(a[1], b[2])

        alice_points += min(a[2], b[0])

    if b_copy[0] != 0:

        bob_points += min_val
        b_copy[0] -= min_val
        if b_copy[0] != 0:
            min_val = min(b_copy[0], a[0])
            bob_points += min_val
            b_copy[0] -= min_val
    if b_copy[1] != 0:
        min_val = min(b_copy[1], a[2])
        bob_points += min_val
        b_copy[1] -= min_val
        if b_copy[1] != 0:

            bob_points += min_val

    if b_copy[2] != 0:

        bob_points += min_val
        b_copy[2] -= min_val
        if b_copy[2] != 0:
            min_val = min(b_copy[2], a[2])
            bob_points += min_val
            b_copy[2] -= min_val

    print(f"{test_count - bob_points} {alice_points}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
